synth.notes:
Ring A1/A2 moves y-/+6 with the beam. It carries blocks overlapping the beam and chain-pushes blocks it hits. If any block would leave the colour-4 field, the whole vertical move is cancelled; this decides the block A1 [arm] y vs no_change case at step 56, and needs no hidden state.
A4/A3 change beam w by 6. A block at x == tip-5 on the beam rows hooks the beam, whatever its tag; then every block fully on the beam moves with the tip. Otherwise an extend pushes the swept 6-col strip. This is the step-87 fix. If the group would leave the field, the beam moves alone.
Tags: a hooked next becomes collected when every other on-beam block is collected, and the next todo in legend-x order becomes next. A collected block off the beam reverts. The legend square centre 2x2 shows 0 while its block is collected. Clicks change nothing.
Background: colour 4 in the field; rail cols outside the field use 2 iff (y-top-2)%6<2, else 3; everything else is 5. The beam row j, col i is 2 iff (i+j)%3==1.
